title: Moya-xiviri Lowu Tsakeriwaka Lowu Vutisaka Vulawuri
intro: Eka tibuku ta matimu ta Quran, a ku hanya munhu loyi rifuwo ni vutivi bya yena swi veke ntsheketo. Moya-xiviri lowu wu hume emisaveni wu ri ni swikhaviso ni rifuwo leri a ri hlamarisa vahlaleri, hambiswiritano timbilu ta vona ti tikukumuxa hi ku tikukumuxa. Hlanganyela na hina loko hi ri karhi hi paluxa xihundla xa yin’wana ya mintsheketo ya xitsundzuxo swinene ya Quran, laha vukulu bya swilo leswi vonakaka byi hlanganaka na makumu yo titsongahata ehansi ka misava leyi velekeke rifuwo ra vona.
clues: Ndzi hume emisaveni ndzi khavisiwe hi swikhaviso leswi a swi koka mahlo ya un’wana ni un’wana.
A ndzi ri ni rifuwo lerikulu ni vutivi lebyi dzikeke lebyi ndzi hambaniseke ni van’wana.
Loko murhumiwa a fika a vitana vanhu eka Allah, ndzi kanakane vulawuri bya vona hi ku tikukumuxa.
Lava a va ndzi rhendzerile va hlevetele leswaku tintswalo ta Allah a hi xona xihlovo xa rifuwo ra mina.
Vanhu va mina va hlamarisiwe hi vukulu bya mina naswona va navele vuyelo lebyi fanaka ni bya mina.
Swivumbeko swa mina leswi hlamarisaka swi mitiwe swi helela emisaveni tanihi nxupulo wa Xikwembu.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
